out.title: Prashant Verma reappointed Chief Information Security Officer for three years
out.summary: Board reappointed Prashant Verma as Chief Information Security Officer effective 1 February 2027 for three years, subject to regulatory approvals; he has held the CISO role since February 2024.

person.name: Prashant Verma
person.bio: CISO of Bajaj Finance since 1 February 2024; ~21 years in security domain; joined as head of Cyber Risk Unit 7 years ago; CISSP, co-author of security books.
